correctness_gate: All completed game records, replay arrays, optimizer and final parameters must match exactly. If not, retain timing but do not call it a pure systems speedup.
hypothesis: A local inference executable removes the global active-count reduction per neural call and improves equal-work 9x9 training throughput.
primary_metric: Slowest-host full training-segment wall time for 512 turns; checkpoints and host I/O included; compilation and staging reported separately.
protocol: One candidate pilot for correctness, then three fresh interleaved baseline/candidate pairs. No concurrent evaluation or additional workloads during measured segments. Same seed is deliberate for systems controls, not an independent learning seed study.
scientific_controls: Same seed, actor identities, weights initialization, CNN architecture, precision, searches, replay sampling, global learner batches, update schedule and CPU sets.
